module_summary: include/themes.h is the public theme API: the element structs (image_texture_t, mutable_image_t, mutable_text_t, items_list_t, theme_element_t, theme_elems_t), the big theme_t with twelve element families, hint and glyph-set enums, and the theme loader/catalog prototypes implemented in themes.cpp. src/gfx/themeelems.cpp holds the per-element code split out of themes.cpp: the devices= filter vocabulary and gates, collision-aware text rooms, the init/draw/end functions for StaticText, GameCountText, AttributeText, StaticImage, GameImage, Background, AttributeImage, MenuIcon, MenuText, BdmIndex, ItemsList (with center-out cover warming), SaveIcon, ItemText, HintText and InfoHintText, the per-row cover-element redirect (thmGetElemForItem) and the user wallpaper load/apply. themes.cpp's loader calls the init functions and wires the draw pointers; coverflow.cpp, grid.cpp and psbbnflow.cpp reuse the image helpers through themeint.h.

reusable_helpers.name: thmParseDeviceList
reusable_helpers.what: parses a comma-separated device name list into a bitmask with strtok_r (thread-safe tokenizing)

reusable_helpers.name: thmTextRoom
reusable_helpers.what: free horizontal room for text on a row band given obstacle boxes and the screen edge

reusable_helpers.name: freeImageTexture
reusable_helpers.what: unloads a GSTEXTURE from VRAM and frees its pixels, CLUT, name and the holder

reusable_helpers.name: initImageTexture
reusable_helpers.what: loads a theme PNG (disk path or embedded internal texture) into an image_texture_t, with optional overlay corner keys

reusable_helpers.name: getGameImageTextureEx
reusable_helpers.what: eligibility-checked game art fetch through the texture cache (priority flag, PS1 id key, folder/hidden/BG gates)

reusable_helpers.name: getGameImageCached
reusable_helpers.what: returns already-resident game art only, never queues a read

reusable_helpers.name: thmWallpaperLoad
reusable_helpers.what: reads a PNG header to reject oversize images before decoding, then loads an 8-bit palettised PNG

reusable_helpers.name: drawHintEntry
reusable_helpers.what: draws one button glyph with or without its translated label and returns the next x

findings.title: initImageInternalTexture duplicates initImageTexture's themePath==NULL branch and makes a failed internal load run twice
findings.problem: For a built-in theme (themePath NULL) initMutableImage first calls initImageInternalTexture, which does texLookupInternalTexId + texLoadInternal; if that fails it calls initImageTexture(NULL, ...), whose themePath==NULL branch (712-719) does the same lookup and load again. texLoadInternal(-1) already returns ERR_BAD_FILE (textures.cpp:1007), so initImageTexture alone gives the identical result. initImageInternalTexture also ignores its themeConfig parameter.
findings.fix: Delete initImageInternalTexture and the 'if (!themePath)' block at 893-895; the following initImageTexture call already handles a NULL themePath.
findings.benefit: 26 source lines removed; one static function (~150 bytes of .text, INFERRED) and a repeated failed lookup per missing built-in default texture.
findings.evidence: Read themeelems.cpp:699-784 and 893-898. Grep initImageInternalTexture over src/RiptOPL: definition 762 and single call 895 only. textures.cpp:1131-1134 texLoadInternal -> texLoadAll(texture, NULL, texId, NULL, 0); textures.cpp:1007 'if (texId == -1 || !internalDefault[texId].texture) return ERR_BAD_FILE'. Both paths store the name and free on failure the same way.

findings.title: Overlay-or-plain image draw block copied three times (StaticImage, GameImage, AttributeImage)
findings.problem: Each draw function repeats the same 8 lines: rmDrawOverlayPixmap with the element geometry and the overlay's eight corner fields, then rmDrawPixmap of overlayTexture2, else a plain rmDrawPixmap. Only the inlay texture and the element differ (in drawStaticImage the overlay inlay is defaultTexture, which equals bgPicture there because a Background never reads an overlay key, line 860).
findings.fix: Add one static helper (element, mutable_image_t, inlay GSTEXTURE) holding this block and call it from the three places.
findings.justification: The same 8-line block exists three times in one file; one ~10-line helper plus three one-line calls removes about 11 lines and three copies of a long 18-argument call.
findings.benefit: ~11 source lines net; two inlined copies of the rmDrawOverlayPixmap argument setup (~200 bytes .text, INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read the three blocks. Grep rmDrawOverlayPixmap( over src: the three calls here plus coverflow.cpp:341, grid.cpp:324, psbbnflow.cpp:169 (those use their own geometry and colour, not included). themeelems.cpp:860-863 shows Background elements never load an overlay, so bgPicture==defaultTexture in the overlay branch of drawStaticImage.

findings.title: Eight hand-unrolled overlay corner key reads in initImageTexture
findings.problem: The eight <name>_overlay_ulx..lry keys are read with eight copies of snprintf + configGetInt + assign (24 lines). configGetInt leaves the output untouched when the key is absent (config.cpp:420-428) and the texture is calloc'd, so each can read straight into the field.
findings.fix: Loop over a small static table of the eight key suffixes paired with the eight field pointers (or make the corners an int[8]) and call configGetInt(themeConfig, prop, field) once in the loop.
findings.justification: Replaces 24 repeated lines with a ~7-line loop and table; no behaviour change.
findings.benefit: ~17 source lines removed; seven fewer inlined snprintf/configGetInt sequences (~300 bytes .text, INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read themeelems.cpp:699-760 (texture is calloc'd at 703). include/config.h:324 configGetInt forwards to ConfigSet::getInt; src/core/config.cpp:420-428 writes *value only when the key exists. Fields are consecutive ints at include/themes.h:14-21.

findings.title: malloc followed by field-by-field zeroing instead of calloc in four init functions
findings.problem: initMutableText, initMutableImage, initBasic and initItemsList malloc a struct and then zero or NULL most fields one by one (initBasic even comments that it must, 1614); initImageTexture/initImageInternalTexture set name=NULL right after calloc. About 33 of these lines only write 0/NULL.
findings.fix: Use calloc in the four init functions and delete every explicit 0/NULL store; keep only the non-zero defaults (-1 cache ids, currentCount -1, showRun 1, endElem). Delete the two 'texture->name = NULL' lines after calloc.
findings.benefit: ~33 source lines removed and fewer stores in the generated code (~100 bytes .text, INFERRED); new fields can no longer be left uninitialised by accident.
findings.evidence: Read the cited ranges. Count of pure zero/NULL stores: 212,214-217 (5); 815-826 plus RA 827-829 (15); 1611,1612,1614-1619,1621,1622 (10); 2134,2140,2141 (3); 704, 768 (2). All other fields of those structs are assigned later in the same functions.

findings.title: The twelve element families are enumerated by hand five times (12 findDuplicate calls plus four arrays in themes.cpp)
findings.problem: initMutableImage calls findDuplicate twelve times, once per family; themes.cpp spells the same twelve-pointer list as a local array in four more functions (one with the first entry dropped). Adding a family means editing all of them.
findings.fix: Keep one list: either make the families an indexed array in theme_t (named indices) or add one small function in themes.cpp that fills theme_elems_t *[12] for a theme (declared in themeint.h), and loop over it in initMutableImage and the four themes.cpp sites.
findings.justification: The same 12-entry enumeration appears five times; one 5-line accessor and short loops remove roughly 12 lines and the risk of a family missing from one copy.
findings.benefit: ~12 source lines net; 11 fewer inlined 7-argument calls in initMutableImage (~250 bytes .text, INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read themeelems.cpp:871-882 and themes.cpp:194-209, plus grep 'theme_elems_t \*\w+\[\d*\] = {' over src: themes.cpp:196 (12), 334 (12), 355 (8, a different subset), 1122 (11, all but main), 1666 (6 mains, different subset), 1855 (12). Grep findDuplicate: only the 12 calls here and the prototype themeint.h:104.

findings.title: Element init chain carries parameters that are unused or always passed the same constant
findings.problem: initMutableText ignores themePath and theme, and both callers pass alias=NULL, DISPLAY_ALWAYS, SIZING_NONE. findDuplicate's overlayTexture is discarded with (void) and the function is exported in themeint.h though only this file calls it. initMutableImage's defaultTexture/overlayTexture, initGameImage's texture/overlay, initStaticImage's imageName, initBackground's texture and initItemsList's decorator are NULL at every call site; each is only a seed for a configGetStr.
findings.fix: Drop these parameters and use locals initialised to the constant; make findDuplicate static without overlayTexture, delete its themeint.h prototype and shorten the 657-666 comment to one line; in initItemsList read straight into itemsList->decorator.
findings.benefit: ~10 source lines removed and 13 fewer arguments across 8 signatures and ~20 call sites; no ELF change expected (INFERRED, -O2 already propagates constants for static callees).
findings.evidence: Grep over src/RiptOPL: initMutableText calls 469, 622 only. initMutableImage calls 943, 1339, 1581, 1729, grid.cpp:671, coverflow.cpp:356, all with NULL,NULL or (imageName/texture NULL from callers). initGameImage calls themes.cpp:702,756,759 (texture,overlay NULL); initStaticImage themes.cpp:705 (NULL); initBackground themes.cpp:103,113,709 (texture NULL); initItemsList themes.cpp:153,732,739,743,747,751 (decorator NULL). findDuplicate: only calls 871-882 and prototype themeint.h:104.

findings.title: Checks for ELEM_TYPE_COVERFLOW can never match: Coverflow elements are created as ELEM_TYPE_GAME_IMAGE
findings.problem: themes.cpp:784 creates a Coverflow element with initBasic(..., ELEM_TYPE_GAME_IMAGE, ...) and no code assigns ELEM_TYPE_COVERFLOW to elem->type, so the '!= ELEM_TYPE_COVERFLOW' term in thmElemBox and the '&& e->type != ELEM_TYPE_COVERFLOW' term in thmFindElemBySuffixEx are always true. The comment above thmFindElemBySuffixEx (1366-1367) already says Coverflow is typed GAME_IMAGE.
findings.fix: Delete the ELEM_TYPE_COVERFLOW comparisons at 367 and 1380.
findings.evidence: Grep ELEM_TYPE_COVERFLOW over src: themeelems.cpp:367, 1380; themes.cpp:644 (a type-name string compare in thmAutoFitElem, valid) and themes.cpp:780 (name compare). Read themes.cpp:780-785: initBasic(..., ELEM_TYPE_GAME_IMAGE, ...). initBasic sets elem->type only from its argument (themeelems.cpp:1610).

findings.title: drawItemsList: identical title-draw code in both decorator branches and the decorator test recomputed per row
findings.problem: Lines 2075-2078 and 2082-2085 are the same fntRenderStringFit/fntRenderString pair, and the branch condition at 2060-2061 is exactly hasDecorator computed at 2017-2018, so isHiddenArtworkCache (two strcmp) runs again for every visible row each frame.
findings.fix: Test hasDecorator for the decorator icon block only, then draw the title once after it; delete the else branch.
findings.benefit: ~8 source lines removed; one isHiddenArtworkCache call per visible row per frame saved.
findings.evidence: Read themeelems.cpp:2009-2107. hasDecorator (2017-2018) is const and uses the same expression as 2060-2061; itemsList is not modified inside the row loop.

findings.title: Small redundant checks in drawGameImage and initMutableImage
findings.problem: drawGameImage opens 'if (isBackground)' twice in a row (1234 and 1239); selImg and cfImg are tested for NULL right after covElem->extended / cfElem->extended were tested non-NULL; initMutableImage has two consecutive identical 'if (type != ELEM_TYPE_BACKGROUND)' blocks.
findings.fix: Merge the two isBackground blocks and the two type != BACKGROUND blocks; delete the 'selImg != NULL &&' and 'cfImg != NULL &&' terms.
findings.benefit: ~5 source lines removed; no ELF change expected (INFERRED, the compiler folds these).

findings.title: Three forwarding wrappers: getGameImageTexture, thmFindElemBySuffix, thmGetItemSource
findings.problem: getGameImageTexture only calls getGameImageTextureEx(..., 0); thmFindElemBySuffix only calls thmFindElemBySuffixEx(..., 0); thmGetItemSource ignores item and returns menu->item->userdata. This is C++, so default arguments cover the first two, and the third is a one-field read.
findings.fix: Give getGameImageTextureEx a default isPriority = 0 and thmFindElemBySuffixEx a default declaredOnly = 0 (renaming them to the short names), delete the two wrappers; replace thmGetItemSource(menu, item) with menu->item->userdata at its 7 call sites and delete it. The stubs in .github/scripts/test_psbbn_flow.py:121,215-216 need the same rename.
findings.benefit: ~12 source lines and 3 prototypes removed; two tiny call frames (INFERRED, gc-sections keeps them since they are called).
findings.evidence: Grep over src/RiptOPL: getGameImageTexture callers themeelems.cpp:1282, 2004, psbbnflow.cpp:155, grid.cpp:308, coverflow.cpp:247, 292; thmFindElemBySuffix callers themes.cpp:436, themeelems.cpp:1496; thmGetItemSource callers psbbnflow.cpp:155,269, grid.cpp:83,275,308,517, coverflow.cpp:65. Test stubs at .github/scripts/test_psbbn_flow.py:121, 215, 216.

findings.title: drawAttributeImage tests 'built-in theme' two different ways; one exact test makes the inner glyph fallback dead
findings.problem: The outer test uses thmGetFilePath(thmGetGuiValue())==NULL (the selected theme id, which can differ from gTheme while a switch is pending or abandoned), so the disk-theme branch carries a second fallback keyed on cache->prefix()==NULL, which is exact for the element being drawn (the cache was created with themePath at line 888). Both draw the same embedded glyph.
findings.fix: Use 'attributeImage->cache->prefix() == NULL' as the single built-in test at 1535 and delete the inner fallback block and its comment (1557-1571).
findings.benefit: ~14 source lines removed and one thmGetFilePath call per AttributeImage per frame.
findings.evidence: Read themeelems.cpp:1517-1577 and 884-888 (cacheInitCache(-1, themePath, ...) for attribute images). themes.cpp:2085-2097 filePath returns NULL for built-in ids. That the gui id and gTheme can disagree (the only case where the inner fallback runs) is INFERRED from the abandoned-load path mentioned at themes.h:368-370, not traced.

findings.title: Unused or duplicate includes and a duplicate prototype in themeelems.cpp
findings.problem: themeint.h is included twice (lines 4 and 6); themecatalog.h (class ThemeCatalog), sound.h (audio/sfx/bgm) and time.h are included but nothing in the file uses them; the local prototype of thmGetElemForItem at 1106 repeats themeint.h:95, which is already included.
findings.fix: Delete the second themeint.h include, the themecatalog.h, sound.h and time.h includes, and the local prototype with its comment (1104-1106).
findings.benefit: 7 lines removed; slightly faster compile; no ELF change.
findings.evidence: Read the whole file. Grep in themeelems.cpp for ThemeCatalog|catalog: only the include and a comment at 30. Grep for time(|clock(|time_t|sfx|bgm|audio: no hits. sound.h declares only audio/sfx/bgm functions. include/themeint.h:95 has the same thmGetElemForItem prototype. Confidence Med only because a transitively needed declaration would show at compile time.

findings.title: Stale comments naming a removed function (guiAlignMenuHints) and old .c files, plus a misplaced and a commented-out line
findings.problem: guiAlignMenuHints no longer exists (uidraw.cpp has only guiAlignSubMenuHints) but three comments here and one in menusys.cpp explain the code by it; comments cite opl.c, textures.c, menusys.c and themes.c, which are now .cpp; themes.h:320 ends thmHintRank's line with a comment that belongs to thmGlyphSetRefresh (317); 2143 is a commented-out assignment.
findings.fix: Reword the guiAlignMenuHints comments to name hintEntryWidth/drawHintText, fix the file names, move the 320 trailing comment to line 317, and delete line 2143.
findings.evidence: Grep guiAlignMenuHints over src: only comments at themeelems.cpp:2256, 2273, 2311 and menusys.cpp:151; no definition. uidraw.cpp:12-86 defines guiDrawIconAndText, guiDrawIconAndLiteralText, guiAlignSubMenuHints. Repo sources are .cpp (brief section 1, 120 C++ files in src/).
